scientific_integrity: An all-finite-extension-field proof is provided; two independent finite algorithms check q=2,4 and one also checks q=8. Enumeration is not used as infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to a four-dimensional exponent-two monomial quotient in characteristic two; counts fixed subalgebras by dimension and isomorphism type, not embeddings/conjugacy classes; literature priority is provisional.
title: Fixed-subalgebra spectra and a binary symmetry gap in a four-dimensional monomial algebra
